result.summary: The image shows a narrow one-way urban street with continuous sidewalks on both sides and parallel parking along the left curb. While the narrow roadway width naturally helps to moderate vehicle speeds, the environment lacks marked pedestrian crossings and features visual obstructions from parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: A row of parked cars on the left side of the street creates a visual barrier, making it difficult for drivers to see pedestrians who might step into the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked pedestrian crossings visible in this block, which may lead to unpredictable crossing behavior.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban alleyway characterized by significant obstructions from large waste containers and uneven pavement. While the narrow geometry likely restricts vehicle speeds, the lack of dedicated pedestrian space and poor sightlines created by the dumpsters reduce overall safety.

hazards.name: Large Dumpsters
hazards.description: Multiple large trash bins obstruct the walkway and create significant blind spots for both pedestrians and any entering vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the alleyway entrance and further down the path

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: The alley surface is cracked and uneven, presenting a tripping hazard for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Waste Management Consolidation
interventions.description: Relocate dumpsters to a designated, enclosed area off the main pedestrian path to clear the walkway and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Alley Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and level the alley pavement to eliminate tripping hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install building-mounted lighting to improve visibility and security within the alley environment.
